steps.content: [2026 Tumbler Ridge shooting] On February 10, 2026, a mass shooting occurred in Tumbler Ridge, British Columbia, Canada. On that afternoon, Jesse Van Rootselaar killed her mother and half-brother at their home before going to Tumbler Ridge Secondary School, where she killed six people and injured 27 others before killing herself. Van Rootselaar was a former student of the school. The incident was the deadliest mass shooting in Canada since the Nova Scotia attacks in 2020 and the deadliest school shooting in Canada since the École Polytechnique massacre in 1989. | other articles: Tumbler Ridge Secondary School, Tumbler Ridge

In the mass shooting at Tumbler Ridge Secondary School on February 10, 2026, six people were killed, and 27 others were injured. The shooter, Jesse Van Rootselaar, also killed her mother and half-brother before the school shooting. 

FINAL: 6 people were killed.
